listing.name: Spider-Man 2 (PS2) — Spider-Man-2-PS2-Recomp (saltyboosack-blip)
listing.summary: This experimental source-only native implementation is explicitly not playable. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own extracted USA SLUS20776 files, including AMALGA.PAK, MOVIES.PAK, SOUNDS.PAK, IOPRP300.IMG and IRX files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate source and build locally, keeping the output private. This is separate from the original-Xbox implementation.
